title: DSelect-k: Differentiable Selection in the Mixture of Experts with Applications to Multi-T
summary: Applies DSelect-k — a differentiable, sparse gate for mixture-of-experts models that selects a fixed number of experts (e.g., 2 of 4) while remaining trainable end to end — to Meridian's multi-task ranking models, packaged as a drop-in Keras layer.
